snippet.title: So I made an "Annoying" Difficulty in Minecraft...
snippet.description:
🕹 Get a browser that’s literally better at everything: https://operagx.gg/Fundy3  Sponsored by Opera GX!

THE COMPETITION:
Over the next 30 days, the person with the fastest time beating Minecraft WITH this mod installed, wins $1000

RULES:
- Don't use any other mod or resource pack during your run.
- Record the entire session from joining the world to beating the ender dragon, and post it on YouTube with the #AnnoyingDifficulty. (so I can find it)
- Difficulty must be set to 'Normal'.
- Must be a random seed, and show it in the video.
- You can't play on a server, but you CAN have multiple people behind one computer. (which might be handy...)
- You are allowed to use funny helper programs, like autoclickers or for finding the stronghold.
- And most important, don't be sketchy; if the run seems odd or dishonest in any way, I will be biased and disqualify it.

THE MOD:
https://modrinth.com/mod/annoyingdifficulty

(There probably will be bugs in my mod. I'll try to fix them... maybe)

Did you know subscribing is free? Pretty neat, you should check it out!

#Fundy #Minecraft
